title: Synth Relationships
lesson: Two sources meet at one output. Colour identifies ownership without copying an engine illustration.

title: Envelope Stages
lesson: Four coloured stages and four stable readout columns. Units share the value baseline.

title: Sample Boundaries
lesson: Cached peaks, four distinct boundaries and a small live cursor layer. Recompute peaks when sample data changes.

title: Drum Selection
lesson: Selection uses an outline and position as well as colour. Keep pad geometry fixed when selecting a voice.

title: Effect Relationships
lesson: Repeat height explains feedback. Store the stable guide and update only the changing repeat representation.

title: Modulation Routing
lesson: Source, depth and destination form a readable route. The host example is a static snapshot.

title: Step And Play Position
lesson: Notes use Blue; the white frame identifies the play position separately. Update only affected steps.

title: Tape Position
lesson: Four lanes and a playhead communicate time without reel animation. The ruler and clips can be retained geometry.

title: Four Control Lanes
lesson: The physical encoder order is repeated in colour, position and track labels. Meter and fader state have separate jobs.

title: Frequency Regions
lesson: Three bands meet at a shared neutral line. Rebuild the response only when relevant controls change.

title: Dynamics Feedback
lesson: A stable transfer diagram and a small meter layer keep configuration and live activity distinct.

title: One Dominant Value
lesson: Large tempo with Small units and Medium supporting values. The duplicate control value demonstrates its encoder mapping.

title: Input And Level
lesson: A labelled source feeds a segmented meter. Dim segments are decoration; the source and gain stay readable.

title: Recording State
lesson: Elapsed time and the word RECORDING carry the state. Colour alone is insufficient. No decorative rotation is needed.
